shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'uikit|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button DropdownMenu Icon Text ThemeProvider TextInput Modal'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button DropdownMenu Icon Text ThemeProvider TextInput Modal && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md && rg -n '"'^#|DropdownMenu|--g-color-base-float|--g-border-radius'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-7.md | head -90 && test -d node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>require('fs').writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',t))\" && rg -o '.{0,60}(ChevronDown|Pencil|Copy|ArrowDownToLine|TrashBin|FileText|ArrowLeft|Ellipsis|CircleQuestion|Check|Layers|ArrowUpRight).{0,90}' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | head -28 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Popup/Popup.d.ts | head -100 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -90 && rg 'ChevronDown|Pencil|Copy|ArrowDownToLine|TrashBin|FileText|ArrowLeft|CircleQuestion|Check|Layers|ArrowUpRight|Plus|Folder|CircleInfo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/base.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/sfx.scss | head -95 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/common/spacing.scss"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'ChevronDown|Pencil|Copy|ArrowDownToLine|TrashBin|FileText|ArrowLeft|CircleQuestion|Check|Layers|ArrowUpRight|Plus|Folder|CircleInfo|Archive|ArrowShapeTurnUpRight|CircleCheck' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts && head -95 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/base.scss && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/sfx.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/common/spacing.scss && rg -n -- '--g-button-(background|text|border)|--g-menu' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/Menu.css | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'Xmark|Link|ChevronRight|Lock' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/text.scss | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/Menu.css | head -90 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && rg -- '--g-border-radius-(xs|s|m|l|xl)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/common | head -20 && sed -n '90,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/Menu.d.ts | head -75 && git status --short"
